Root Scope: Organizations that are cooperative partners of CERT@VDE.
CNA Scope: Products of CERT@VDE cooperative partners and brands listed at https://cert.vde.com/en/cna/. Also, industrial and infrastructure control systems (and its components) of European Union (EU) based vendors unless covered by the scope of another CNA. Partners and brands include but are not limited to: ADS-TEC Industrial IT, Auma, sipos, Beckhoff, Bender, Bucher Automation, CLAAS, 365FarmNet, Satinfo, Carlo Gavazzi Controls, Codesys, DURAG GROUP, Draeger, Endress+Hauser, Euchner, Festo Didactic, Festo, Frauscher, GEA, HIMA, Harman, Helmholz, Hilscher, K4 DIGITAL, KEB, Krohne, Kuka, Lenze, BHN Services, MB connect line, Miele, Murrelektronik, PHOENIX CONTACT, Etherwan Systems, Innominate, Pepperl+Fuchs, Pilz, SMA, SWARCO, Trumpf, TRUMPF Laser, TRUMPF Werkzeugmaschinen, VARTA Storage, VEGA, WAGO, M&M Software, Weidmueller, Welotec, Wiesemann & Theis, ifm.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by CERT.PL, and vulnerabilities reported to CERT.PL for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Esri products only, including ArcGIS.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities discovered in Extreme Networks, Inc.’s products and services.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Kubernetes issues only.
Radiometer products only.
Johnson Controls products only.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
All Temporal Technologies software.
Vivo issues only.
Microchip Technology products only.
Check Point Security Gateways product line only, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Check Point that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Adobe issues only.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
GitHub Enterprise Server issues only.
Pegasystems products only.
Vulnerabilities in AMI firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by AMI that are not covered by another CNA scope.
AMD branded products and technologies only.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
Palantir products and technologies only.
Samsung Mobile Galaxy products, personal computers, and related services only.
All Rockwell Automation products.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
NVIDIA issues only.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
Yandex issues only.
Genetec products and solutions only.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and ProLeiT.
NEC issues only.
Xerox Corporation issues only.
All Netskope products and services.
All CrowdStrike products.
Yugabyte products only.
Forcepoint products only.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Ericsson issues only.
Vulnerability assignment related to FSI’s vulnerability coordination role in the South Korea financial sector that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Synology issues only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by researchers in collaboration with Maritime Hacking Village that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Lexmark products only.

items.organizationName: Monash University - Cyber Security Incident Response Team
items.scope: Vulnerabilities in any Monash University developed products, or vulnerabilities identified in third-party vendor products used by Monash University, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.

Root Scope: Japan organizations.
CNA Scope: Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.

All Cisco products, and any third-party research targets that are not in another CNA’s scope. Cisco will not issue a CVE ID for issues reported on products that are past the Last Day of Support milestone, as defined on Cisco’s End-of-Life Policy, which is available at https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/eos-eol-policy.html.
Juniper issues only.
Tenable products and third-party products it researches not covered by another CNA.
